name: gastown
summary: Gas Town (gt): tasks are beads in each rig's bd database; gt adds dispatch (sling), a per-agent work pointer (hook), grouping (convoy) and completion (done).
verified: written from Gas Town's README, docs/reference.md and docs/glossary.md at upstream commit de2ce8e (2026-10-25); gt is not installed on the authoring host, so no action has been run

orchestrator.comment: Actions an orchestrator performs on a task. agentctl would call these instead of (or as well as) its own start/stop when a project's tasks belong to Gas Town. They are optional for every other adapter.

dispatch.effect: assigns the task to a worker in rig {target}, starts it, and puts the task on that worker's hook

complete.effect: run by the worker: submits its branch to the merge queue and ends its session
